title: every widget must have a visible example
body:
Every widget page documentation should include visual examples of different widget use cases. We currently only display an example code snippet, not the actual result.

At least one classical example usage and one HOC example per widget.

Related to #1237

comments.body: Maybe this could be easily fixed using https://getstorybook.io/
I dont know if the workflow/result of getstorybook can be easily integrated within our doc website. I do not want to have to generate two different websites (one for documentation, one for overview)
